scope: Reviewed account lifecycle claims only; not full six-source consolidation.

rows.requirement: Require exact account/actor approval, ownership continuity, all owned repositories/private forks/wikis/issues/PRs/Pages inventory and tested preservation before deletion. Respect managed-user prohibition and GHES owner consultation. Incomplete source prerequisites stay unresolved; administrator cannot be assumed able to restore deleted content.
rows.negative_test: A confirmation dialog or repository-only clone cannot pass complete custody; sole-owner transfer cannot be omitted; backup existence cannot certify restore.

rows.requirement: Distinguish rename transfer from deletion of packages/images and independently inventory consumers. Bind public visibility, prior-week >100 clone/Actions-use counts, Marketplace actions and public-image >5,000 downloads; account-name reuse does not undo pair-specific permanent retirement.
rows.negative_test: Rename package-transfer behavior cannot pass deletion recovery; account-name release after 90 days cannot certify retired repository/image names reusable.

rows.requirement: Preserve GHES<3.21 conversion concept against broadly versioned reference side effects and collaborator ambiguity. Exact product/version/operation must be independently resolved before a change; modern movement preserving personal account is not irreversible legacy conversion.
rows.negative_test: Broad reference metadata cannot grant conversion on unsupported versions; intact repositories cannot prove credentials/apps/attribution/private forks preserved.

rows.requirement: Inventory repository/org permissions, admin invitations, noreply attribution, issues/PRs/discussions and Achievements separately. Require actual invitation acceptance and scoped access evidence; copied data or account-name clues do not transfer authority.
rows.negative_test: Account merge cannot automatically pass inherited permissions, transferred noreply commits or transferred Achievements.

rows.requirement: Distinguish read-only scan, observed feature configuration, manifest permissions, findings, optional security-update PR writes and new-repository defaults. Native activation remains approval-gated with scoped before/after and behavior evidence.
rows.negative_test: Read-only analysis prose cannot prove security services never write PRs; a defaults checkbox cannot prove current/future estate coverage.

limitations: Negative tests are specifications, not implemented or executed tests.
No account deletion/conversion/merge, credential change or native activation.
Claim identity checks do not certify semantic equivalence, omission completeness or legal rights.
